name: flecha
description: An Arc-style browser built on Chromium (via Electron).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:preload && tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/find.html src/renderer/find.css src/renderer/settings.html src/renderer/settings.css dist/renderer/
